import inspect

import solution
from solution import average_Odd


def test_issue_example_9():
    """Example: average_Odd(9) == 5."""
    # (1+3+5+7+9)/5 = 25/5 = 5
    assert average_Odd(9) == 5


def test_issue_smallest_odd_1():
    """Average of odd numbers till 1 is 1."""
    # 1/1 = 1
    assert average_Odd(1) == 1


def test_issue_till_3():
    """Average of odd numbers till 3 is 2."""
    # (1+3)/2 = 4/2 = 2
    assert average_Odd(3) == 2


def test_issue_till_5():
    """Average of odd numbers till 5 is 3."""
    # (1+3+5)/3 = 9/3 = 3
    assert average_Odd(5) == 3


def test_issue_till_7():
    """Average of odd numbers till 7 is 4."""
    # (1+3+5+7)/4 = 16/4 = 4
    assert average_Odd(7) == 4


def test_issue_till_11():
    """Average of odd numbers till 11 is 6."""
    # (1+3+5+7+9+11)/6 = 36/6 = 6
    assert average_Odd(11) == 6


def test_issue_till_17():
    """Average of odd numbers till 17 is 9."""
    # (1+...+17)/9 = 81/9 = 9
    assert average_Odd(17) == 9


def test_issue_till_25():
    """Average of odd numbers till 25 is 13."""
    # (1+...+25)/13 = 169/13 = 13
    assert average_Odd(25) == 13


def test_issue_large_99():
    """Average of odd numbers till 99 is 50."""
    # (1+...+99)/50 = 2500/50 = 50
    assert average_Odd(99) == 50


def test_contract_exposes_average_Odd():
    """Public interface: solution module exposes average_Odd."""
    assert hasattr(solution, "average_Odd")


def test_contract_single_parameter_n():
    """Public interface: def average_Odd(n) takes parameter n."""
    assert list(inspect.signature(average_Odd).parameters) == ["n"]
